[EN] Val Aureum isn't just important to the amani.

The relics and ruins could illuminate much for the Mysterium and the Valkyon Federation.

That's why we're here. It isn't for diplomacy or trade—it's for power.
[ES] Val Aureum no es solo importante para los amani.

Las reliquias y ruinas podrían aclarar mucho para el Mysterium y la Valkyon Federation.

Por eso estamos aquí. No es por diplomacia o comercio, es por poder.
